```{r}
sens_opt_df = read.csv('data/processed_sensitivity_opt_data.csv')
sens_opt_df = sens_opt_df %>% mutate(across(starts_with("cAb"), log10)) 
sens_opt_df$label = gsub("^(.*?)_", "", sens_opt_df$label, perl=T)
sens_opt_df_list = split(sens_opt_df %>% select(-c(replicate)), sens_opt_df$label)
sens_opt_df
```

```{r warning=FALSE}
DR_Viz = function(dataset){
  std.err = function(x, na.rm = T) sd(x, na.rm = T)/sqrt(length(x))
  
  dataset %>% select(-label) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(target_vector, Conc.),
                   names_to = 'pairs',
                   values_to = 'fluorescence') %>% 
  group_by(Conc., target_vector, pairs) %>%
  summarise(average_fluorescence = mean(fluorescence),
            se = std.err(fluorescence)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=Conc., y=average_fluorescence, color = target_vector))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()+
  labs(title = paste0(dataset$label, " Dose Response"),
       x = 'Spike Protein Concentration (ng/mL)',
       y = "Log(Fluorescence) (A.U.)")+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=average_fluorescence-se, ymax = average_fluorescence+se), width = 0.2)+
  facet_wrap('pairs', scales = 'free')+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,5))+
  scale_x_log10() +
  theme_classic()
}
dr_graph_list = lapply(sens_opt_df_list, DR_Viz)

filenames = str_c(names(dr_graph_list), ".png")
pwalk(list(filenames, dr_graph_list),
      ggsave,
      path = 'sens_opt_dr_plots')
```

```{r}
combined_augment_data = read.csv("Embedded_FS/combined_augmented_data.csv")
combined_augment_data = combined_augment_data %>% select(-c(Replicate, cAb13))
condition_label = sens_opt_df$label
sens_opt_df_umap = sens_opt_df %>% select(-c(label, replicate))
condition_plus_target = paste0(sens_opt_df_umap$target_vector, "_", condition_label)

# Because I'm not sure if UMAP can be precomputed then applied to a test set
# a quick fix

# UMAP visualization
umap_rec = recipe(~., data = combined_augment_data %>% filter(Conc. >= 0.01 & Conc. <= 250)) %>% 
  update_role(c(Conc., target_vector), new_role = "id") %>% 
  step_normalize(all_predictors()) %>% 
  step_umap(all_predictors(),
            min_dist = 0.05)

umap_prep = prep(umap_rec)

# Here I construct the UMAP embedding by first training on the augmented data, then
# "predicting" on the new data. NOTE: I construct the manifold representation
# with ALL variants, then just filter out WT and Beta to make the visualization less cluttered
combined_data_umap = bake(umap_prep, new_data = NULL) %>% 
  filter(target_vector == "Beta" | target_vector == "WT") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, label = round(Conc., 3)))+
  geom_point(aes(color = target_vector))+
  geom_text(check_overlap = T, hjust = "inward")+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")+
  theme_classic()+
  labs(title = "UMAP embedding of augmented data embedding")

sens_opt_umap_conc_label = bake(umap_prep, new_data = sens_opt_df_umap) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, label = Conc.))+
  geom_point(aes(color = condition_label))+
  geom_text(check_overlap = T, hjust = "inward")+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")+
  theme_classic()+
  labs(title = "UMAP embedding of sensitivity data projected onto augmented data embedding")

sens_opt_umap_conc_alpha = bake(umap_prep, new_data = sens_opt_df_umap) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, alpha = Conc., label = target_vector))+
  geom_point(aes(color = condition_label))+
  geom_text(check_overlap = T, hjust = "inward")+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")+
  theme_classic()

# To compute this represenation, I include the new data when constructing the intial embedding
sens_opt_combined_data = sens_opt_df_umap
sens_opt_combined_data$target_vector = condition_plus_target
sens_opt_combined_data = bind_rows(sens_opt_combined_data, combined_augment_data) %>% 
  filter(Conc. >= 0.01 & Conc. <= 250)

umap_rec_combined = recipe(~., data = sens_opt_combined_data) %>% 
  update_role(c(Conc., target_vector), new_role = "id") %>% 
  step_normalize(all_predictors()) %>% 
  step_umap(all_predictors(),
            min_dist = 0.1)

umap_prep_combined = prep(umap_rec_combined)


combined_umap_test = bake(umap_prep_combined, new_data = NULL) %>% 
  filter(target_vector != "Omicron" & target_vector != "Delta") 

beta_combined_umap_test = combined_umap_test %>% filter(str_detect(target_vector, "Beta"))
WT_combined_umap_test = combined_umap_test %>% filter(str_detect(target_vector, "WT"))

sens_opt_combined_beta_umap = beta_combined_umap_test %>% 
  ggplot(aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, label = round(Conc., 3)))+
  geom_point(aes(color = target_vector), size = 2)+
  geom_text(check_overlap = T, hjust = "inward")+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")+
  theme_classic()+
  labs(title = 'UMAP embedding of augmented data and sensitivity opt data (Beta)')

sens_opt_combined_wt_umap = WT_combined_umap_test %>% 
  ggplot(aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, label = round(Conc., 3)))+
  geom_point(aes(color = target_vector), size = 2)+
  geom_text(check_overlap = T, hjust = "inward")+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")+
  theme_classic()+
  labs(title = "UMAP embedding of augmented data and sensitivity opt data (WT)")

filename_list = c('combined_data_umap', 'sens_opt_umap_conc_label', 'sens_opt_umap_conc_alpha', 'sens_opt_combined_beta_umap', 'sens_opt_combined_wt_umap')
plots = list(combined_data_umap, sens_opt_umap_conc_label, sens_opt_umap_conc_alpha, sens_opt_combined_beta_umap, sens_opt_combined_wt_umap)
filename_list = str_c(filename_list, ".png")

pwalk(list(filename_list, plots),
      ggsave,
      path = 'sensitivity_umap_plots')
```
